QuestInfo.name: A Name She Couldn't Say
QuestInfo.0: Does #p425# at #m10003007# know anything about the evil spirit somewhere in #m10003000#?
QuestInfo.1: #p425# at #m10003007# couldn't hide the seriousness on her face when I mentioned that #p900014# had been sensing a powerful evil spirit somewhere in #m10003000#. After thinking it over for a while, she said the only one she could think of was the girl at #b#m10003004##k, and asked me to go check on #b#p412##k. Something about this doesn't sit right with me... \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: After some hesitation, I went and met #p412# at #b#m10003004##k. But the girl I hadn't seen in a while... no, the girl's ghost, seemed to know something.

0.0: I see. If #p900014# is sensing a powerful evil presence in #m10003000#, that's not something to question. But if it's not the #o43# deep in the subway, then where on earth could this evil spirit be? Hmm......
0.1: Don't tell me... this powerful evil spirit he's talking about is the ghost of that girl at #m010003004#...? It's true she hasn't been able to leave that hospital in all this time, but she's never once put anyone in danger before. Still, I can't think of anyone else it could be.
0.2: If you tell #p900014# about this right away, he'll go straight to trying to get rid of her. But I want to give her a chance. Would you mind going to see that ghost again?

yes.0: Thank you. Go to #b#m10003004##k and check on #b#p412##k for me. If it turns out she really has become something dangerous, then... I'll go along with #p900014#'s decision, too.

no.0: You're the only one I can ask this of. Please, think it over once more.

1.0: Ah... #h0#... you're the only one who ever comes to see me. Hm...? How have I been these days...? I've just been sitting here alone, thinking things over about the past. My memories are a bit hazy, but... is something the matter?

npc.0: I'm truly hoping, with all my heart, that the powerful evil spirit #p900014# sensed isn't #b#p412##k at #b#m10003004##k.
